red.meaning: This photo carries hidden details that point to you, listed above: a location, a preview copy of the image, or personal details. Anyone who gets the file can read them.
red.pro: Incognito Pro strips the location and other hidden details from a whole folder of photos at once, so your profile photos go up without them.
red.button: Clean all your photos with Pro

amber.meaning: No location, but the file still names things about you: the phone or app that made it, when it was taken, or a username, as listed above.
amber.pro: Incognito Pro strips these details from a whole folder of photos at once, so a dating profile shows your face and nothing about your phone.
amber.button: Strip them from every photo with Pro

green.meaning: This file carries no hidden details we could detect. What's left to check is the picture itself: the street signs, house numbers and buildings behind you.
green.pro: Your other photos may not be this clean. Incognito Pro strips location and other hidden details from a whole folder at once, so you don't have to check them one by one.
green.button: Clean the whole folder with Pro
